data.exact_reserve_text: A positive run-off of GBP 12.1m on the 2014 and prior years' reserves (2013 and prior: GBP 17.1m) was experienced in the year. This change to the previous closed year reserves was 4.9% of the relevant provisions brought forward.

named_events.loss_description: Across all years of account the syndicate projected ultimate gross catastrophe losses of GBP 61.0m with a year-end incurred of GBP 41.0m; ultimate net losses projected GBP 42.8m, largely falling to the 2017 year of account and materially impacting the calendar year result.
Mentioned as one of the major 2017 events (along with Harvey and Caribbean) which the syndicate partially out-performed the market on, but contributed to a calendar year loss.
The syndicate has material exposure to Irish Motor bodily injury claims in the 2015 and 2016 years of account; Irish motor was conservatively reserved to make a loss in final year commentary.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 350.266m. During the year there was a prior-period favourable run-off: a positive run-off of GBP 12.1m on the 2014 and earlier years' reserves was experienced, representing roughly a 3.5% release versus opening gross claims. The prior-year movement is described as a release driven by favourable claims development; however 2017 also experienced major natural catastrophe activity (Harvey, Irma, Maria and California wildfires) which materially impacted the 2017 calendar year underwriting result and produced significant catastrophe losses concentrated in property and reinsurance property lines.
raw_causal_phrases: A positive run-off of GBP 12.1m on the 2014 and prior years' reserves (2013 and prior: GBP 17.1m) was experienced in the year.
In 2017, there has been an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 2.9m (2016: GBP 20.1m) due to lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.
The 2016 year of account deterioration during 2017 is due to fall back exposure to the hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria.
The Syndicate has material exposure to Irish Motor bodily injury claims in the 2015 and 2016 years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening reserve taken from statement of financial position (explicit gross claims outstanding). Prior-year movement (-GBP 12.1m) was taken from the textual note stating 'A positive run-off of GBP 12.1m on the 2014 and prior years' reserves...' which refers to 2014 and earlier years; the claims development triangle (gross) shows little or no movement for older years when compared diagonal-to-diagonal, creating an inconsistency between triangle and narrative; RITC and other reinsurance transfers can distort movement tables. Prior-year movement page is estimated from the note location; if exact page numbering for that note is required, please cross-check the PDF. All monetary values converted from reported GBP '000 to millions. Confidence flags provided where appropriate.
